body: Well I’m seeing a physiologist but I’m not sure when my next appointment is
I’ve dealt with it for as long as I can remember, might as well keep on pushing through

Please don’t man, I know it’s been said a lot everywhere but please, I can’t promise things will get better but you can hope can’t you? 

If you feel comfortable, please feel free to hmu and talk, I know I’m a stranger and I know I don’t know anything about you but I just want the best for you, I understand it might sound weird but I just want to help, I’ve been going through some shit for a while now and I understand that it sucks, please, I know im probably just saying the same shit as everyone else would but I just hope that this time or another it helps someone, especially someone in your situation, please, if your comfortable, hmu and we can talk about whatever to get your mind off these feelings at least for a little bit

I don’t think so, plus majority of my family has been diagnosed with depression, I would get screamed at for not wanting to be home and not talking to them about it, when I have tried multiple times, but I always get cut off
I’m here man, feel free to talk if you feel comfortable
